manifest_row.title: CIBC shrinks event after Whistler tries to bill oil firm for climate change

screening.main_topic: The cancellation of part of a CIBC investment conference after Whistler joined a campaign asking oil companies to compensate municipalities for climate-change-related costs.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change motivates the town’s campaign and its effort to draw attention to the issue, but the report mainly focuses on the campaign’s fallout with energy firms and the conference.
screening.reason: The text contains meaningful climate-related discourse, including municipal costs attributed to climate change and the town’s stated purpose in joining the campaign.
